notes.title: Kittengumi Patch 1.04
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

We've been listening to your feedback, and we went to work to improve Kittengumi: The Sakabato's Thief. And now you can enjoy this improvements in this latest patch. Some of these new additions are:

New backlog menu where you can re-read all the past dialogue.
New font size option in the option menu.
New entering to the scene animation for characters.
New option to mute the sound at the end of a sentence.
Further more, we've fixed small bugs, that you the community, have been reporting to us. Thank you very much for all your support, and stay tuned for future news!

notes.title: Kittengumi celebrates its first month!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

Kittengumi celebrates its first month!

We are very happy to see you sharing your impressions of the game through social networks, but also very grateful for the feedback you give us.

During this month there have been a couple of updates that have improved some things, but we are preparing a big update that will add features and make the title more eye-catching, such as:

-Transition when a character suddenly appears.
-The possibility to look at previous conversations.
-Small "animation" for the characters that are going to speak.

In addition, we will be adding more languages as time goes by so let us know in which one you want to play Kittengumi.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/43a5d4507f6a5ef458be90921a5373a117f6234d.png

Thank you very much for your support and we hope it reaches many more people!

We invite you to send us pictures with your pets, they always cheer up the team.
This time we leave you one with Drako and Crispín:

notes.title: KITTENGUMI: THE SAKABATO'S THIEF IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

KITTENGUMI: THE SAKABATO'S THIEF IS NOW AVAILABLE!

Kittengumi: The Sakabato’s Thief is a visual novel that takes us to an alternate Japan (Nyppon) where the protagonists, a cat and a panda who believes he is a cat, will have to find the thief of the sakabato, one of the treasures of the Kittengumi - a group of samurai cats that protects the safety of Nyedo (Edo), to which they belong.

This will be the characters' first official mission and during this adventure, they will interact with many characters and, depending on the decisions, the story will unfold in different ways, not all of them with a happy ending.

The Sakabato Thief is the first in a collection of visual novels that tell different stories starring the members of this group and that is now available on PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch and Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/9ed7cbaa0c41003082de974f18bcfe61af51da7f.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2469050/Kittengumi_The_Sakabatos_Thief/

Featured Content

      Decide how the story progresses and discover the 10 different endings: Your decisions matter and will determine the path that Ryuudama and Kumaneko choose. Will you catch the thief? Will they get out unharmed? Will you meet all the characters?
      All hand-drawn: Our artist has drawn every character, every setting, and every part of the game with great effort, love, and care.
     Story with lore beyond the main game: This game is the premiere of a saga that will bring many adventures. The game is full of characters, references, and lore beyond the main story.
      Follow the story from any unlocked scene: You can pick up the story from the scene selector and try all the variants without having to start from scratch each time.
      Soundtrack with Japanese instruments: The soundtrack is carefully created with period instruments that will accompany you throughout the adventure.
     Dynamic and battle scenes that narrate some of the most important and remarkable events in the story

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/9dacffc749249dbbd23c7fae5dc481959368afaa.gif

Kittengumi: The Sakabato’s Thief Launches October 13th

The Sakabato has been stolen, and Ryuudama is on a mission to get it back. Try out the different narrative routes to learn about all the characters, locations, and stories behind it. Will you be able to get the canon story on your first try?

The visual novel Kittengumi: The Sakabato Thief will be released on Steam on October 13 in multiple languages and with ten endings to surprise you.

[previewyoutube=sPaHJb2D2i0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Happy Cat Day and Visual Novel Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

Happy Cat Day and Visual Novel Fest!

Discover our love for cats (and all animals).

We are very excited and happy about the reception the demo is getting and since you guys are sharing how much you love it, we wanted to share with you how it all came about.

Before we started Kittengumi we had many meetings about what kind of visual novel to make. We knew we wanted to make one for all audiences, one for those adventure lovers that have been with us since we were kids and, also, we knew we wanted to transmit something.

We have all always liked animals. The writer has a cat shelter behind his house -where they are kept in freedom- which he visits frequently and he has always had animals, just like the rest of the team.

While we were talking, the subject of how much we like animals, how much they have contributed to our lives and the love they transmit came up, and we came to the conclusion that, in part, we may have liked them so much because all the series we watched as children used to star animals that we still love today.

For that reason, we decided to make Kittengumi. A visual novel starring kittens and many other animals. Because this is important, animals can get along regardless of what race they are and it is something we wanted to make clear because we humans sometimes find it very difficult to get along with each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/3b4be864d9ac5a4be719c73c5caef1d906ccf217.jpg

Thus was born the seed of Kittengumi, with the idea that the player would have a good time, love the characters and from then on love the animals more.

P.S: We have received photos of players with their pets through our social networks. We invite you to send us photos through twitter or post them directly in the Steam game community.

notes.title: Kittengumi: everything gets better with Samurai kittens!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44229895/ba68edb55a1592223e1e87ea3d0158b2a880cf47.png

Kittengumi: everything gets better with Samurai kittens!

Cats are an inexhaustible source of narrative resources. Any kitten can fix your most stormy day. But if we're also talking about samurai cats, then I'm sure I've earned your interest. Kittengumi: The Sakabato's Thief is a visual novel developed by Guarida Games Studio, and entirely hand-drawn, where cats become the protagonists of a classic Japanese narrative. Very soon you will have it available so you can start purring and add it to your Wishlist at Playstation Store and Steam

[previewyoutube=A6t3S0-sXHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

It's a day like any other in the city of Nyedo, of faraway Gapon. But at the headquarters of the Kittengumi, a samurai group that watches over security and justice, a great commotion has arisen. The emblematic Sakabato sword has been stolen. This is a huge disgrace for the samurai clan, who will not hesitate to take to the streets to recover their treasure. Together, the young Ryuudama, the panda bear with feline aspirations Kumaneko, the ninja Azuki and other warriors will have to overcome a thousand challenges to discover the thief.

They are relentless, they are brave, they are tough. And, above all, they're cute. Because they are kittens. Kittengumi: The Sakabato Thief is the starting point of a saga that promises to be memorable. And speaking of things to remember, don't forget to add it to your wishlist! Meow.
